//: The config of harness-kit/parallel/unit.mjs and check.mjs for one project. The set-up copies this file to <project>/.harness/kit.json when none is there; edit that copy, never a script. Keys that start with // are notes and are ignored. These defaults are for pytest and were NOT run: Python is not on the PC the kit was built on (2026-11-25). The commands were run only in their tests, with the node --test example beside this file (kit.node.example.json). macOS was not run.
//test_files: How the test files are listed: patterns matched against the files git tracks or does not ignore, paths relative to the project's top, / between folders. ** is any number of folders, * any part of one name. pytest's own default names are below.
//check_one: The command that checks one test file, as a list of words (no shell). {file} is the file's path relative to the project's top; {args} is where a shard's extra words go (dropped when the file has no shards). It runs from the project's top (or the unit's copy, or the landing copy). Exit 0 is a pass; any other exit is a fail (pytest exits 5 when a file collects no tests). On Windows python3 may need to be python.
//check_one_timeout_s: Seconds one check_one run may take before the queue ends it with its whole process tree (no result, not a fail). Above 1500 the queue is told to allow it.
//check_all: The command that checks everything, as a list of words. unit.mjs land runs it at each landing unless test files are named on the command line.
//check_all_timeout_s: Seconds check_all may take before the queue ends it (the landing then counts as no result and is undone, exit 5).
//landing_branch: The branch units land on. Landings happen in a copy of their own (<copies_dir>/_landing), so this branch must not be checked out anywhere else: not your main checkout. unit.mjs makes it from your checkout's HEAD the first time if it does not exist. Merge it into your main branch yourself when you want; nothing is pushed.
//unit_prefix: The start of every unit's branch name: unit.mjs start parser makes the branch u/parser.
//copies_dir: The folder the units' copies (git worktrees) are made in: one folder per unit, and _landing for the landing copy. Relative to the project's top; {project} is the project folder's name. It must lie outside the project and never inside a .claude folder.
//queue_slots: How many heavy commands (test runs) the project's queue runs at once (<project>/.harness/lane). Never above the processor count. check.mjs --measure prints the time at 1, 2, 4 and 8 at once, so you can set this from your own figures. The harness project measured 4 at once costing each run only 6 to 15 % more than alone (SPEEDUPS.md, 'The heavy-command queue').
//shards: A slow test file cut into parts that run at once: the file's path, then one list of extra words per shard, put where {args} stands in check_one. The file then runs as its shards and nothing else, so the shards must cover all its tests. For pytest, e.g. "tests/test_slow.py": [["-k", "test_a or test_b"], ["-k", "not (test_a or test_b)"]]. The harness project cut its slowest file into 4 shards: 221 s alone became 67 to 70 s (SPEEDUPS.md, 'The test suite').
